title: Alphabet Friends
yt_description:
Join Pip and friends to learn letters A, B, and C with fun words that start with them. This song is designed to introduce young children to the basics of the alphabet in a engaging and interactive way. Your child will have fun singing along and learning new words.

🎵 Alphabet Friends

Hello friends
Let's learn
Alphabet fun

A is for Apple
B is for Ball
C is for Cat

A, B, C, fun to see
Letters and words for you and me

A, B, C, fun to see
Letters and words for you and me

Bye friends
See you soon
Alphabet fun

Bouncy Meadow — Kids Songs with Pip, Lulu & Bo
Animation and music created with AI tools, written and reviewed by a human.
